source.description: sys.argv[1] assigned to `root` without normalisation, restriction, or existence check

hops.note: `root` passed as argument to scan(); no sanitisation applied before or at the call site
`root` used directly as the top-level argument to os.walk(); no path normalisation or containment check
`path` constructed via os.path.join(base, name) from os.walk output; value inherits traversal scope of `root`

sink.description: open(path, encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') reads arbitrary files reachable from the user-supplied root; enables unauthorized disclosure of files outside the intended source tree

sanitisationGaps.description: No path normalisation (os.path.realpath/abspath) or prefix check applied to sys.argv[1] before use as root

Directory blocklist ({'.git','node_modules','build','target'}) only filters named directories; it does not prevent traversal outside root when root itself is a relative or absolute path supplied by an untrusted caller
